content_of_post_to_comment: I think the healthiest form of ambition is simply curiosity about your own potential. How good could I get at this? How far could I take it? What would happen if I gave this everything I had for five years? A lot of people kill that curiosity before they ever get an answer. They decide what's realistic based on their environment, their age, their circumstances, or what other people have managed to accomplish. Ambition is just refusing to decide your limits before you've actually reached them.
